label: Jointed Horsetail

Use the reference ONLY for its warm anthotype-inspired plant-pigment contact-print language and palette; create the completely different subject described below. Entirely FLAT soft dusty mauve/rose/rust pigment shadows, granular uneven deposits, pale capillary-vein voids, sun-faded soft contact edges, mottled bleaching and subtle translucent overlap. Darkest muted plum #7D465B, rose #B56D79, rusty apricot #C88E6C. A strong readable tangible natural silhouette with close-up pigment detail. No outline drawing, black ink contour, glossy3D modelling, lighting shadows, paper cutout, cyan blueprint or polished sculpture. Pigment/paper grain occurs ONLY inside the subject marks; the surrounding canvas and open gaps must be true transparent alpha. No rectangular backing, floor, soil mound, halo, frame or border. Entire subject central72% with at least14% empty alpha on every side, every root/leaf/appendage whole. No text, letters, numerals, clocks/dials/readings, UI, logo, watermark or signature. One individual original asset, no collage or panels. JOINTED HORSETAIL: an invented wetland reed colony with THREE unequal thick segmented stalks rooted in one narrow branching rhizome. One stalk forks into a broad fan of short whorled needle leaves; one curls outward at its elbow; the shortest bears a compact cone-shaped pollen head. Clear rhythmic joint nodes and sparse fine radial leaf whorls, a strong tall asymmetric living plant silhouette. No bell flowers, bladder leaves, pitcher mouths, animal, mechanism or container. Flat plant-pigment contact print; the anatomy is shown through bleached tissue/vein patterns, never3D shading.
